Medivant Healthcare is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. Medivant Healthcare is a leading manufacturer of sterile injectable medications, committed to alleviating drug shortages and ensuring patient safety with FDA-registered, cGMP compliant, and US-based facilities. Medivant Healthcare employs 180 people (+23.3% YoY, +34 people), founded in 2015. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, India, Georgia, United Arab Emirates, and United Kingdom).

Uniquely poised as a world class FDA registered outsourcing pharmaceutical manufacturer, Medivant offers the best in the industry when it comes to reliability and management, supply chain transparency, and lower total net cost. *dba Tailstorm Health, Inc.
